Events.Title: The Threshold Watch
Events.Callout: A Shard Bulwark and Lattice Cantor wait beyond the mineral gate. Observe safely or record a challenge.
Events.Objective: Record the challenge, interrupt the Cantor and defeat the finite formation.
Events.Success: The threshold settles. The Forgewrights recognize your work.
Events.Failure: The watch withdrew. Return after its quiet interval.
